title: 4.14 Ana painted her bedroom last year
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
lesson_title: Ana painted her bedroom last year
sub_lesson_title: Ana painted her bedroom last year
goal: Say when something happened with last week, last month and last year (Ana painted her bedroom last year. / Luis washed his car last month.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.14 Months: July to December: A1 finishes the months and the year; A1+ 4.14 uses last with them for the past (last week, last month, last year), after 4.7's -ed and yesterday, 4.8's Did…? and 4.9's didn't. A time cannot be photographed: each photo shows what its person did (two new Flash photos of Ana painting her bedroom and Luis washing his car, A1 4.7's kitchen and clothes, Luis's TV and Diego's painting), a picture bank changes only the activity, and Listen sets last week, last month, last year and yesterday against each other. A1 4.14's own months come back after last (Diego painted last August. / They cleaned the living room last December.), set against other months in Listen.
prerequisite: A1 4.12-4.14 week, month, year; A1+ 4.7 -ed and yesterday; A1+ 4.8 Did…?; A1+ 4.9 didn't; A1+ 4.11 it.
speaking_outcome: Say last with a clear st (LAST WEEK); painted has two syllables (PAIN-tid) and washed ends in t (WOSHT). Do not require native-like speed.
